board.name: Arizona Regulatory Board of Physician Assistants

cycleYears.reason: The license renews every two years.

certificationInLieu.note: Arizona deems the hours met by certification from a certifying body the board approves; the board's naming of NCCPA is not yet verified.

notes.text: During the first biennial license period the Board sets a pro-rated number of hours.

topics.label: Opioid related, substance use disorder related or addiction related CE, part of the 40 hours

agreement.text: Under 8,000 board certified clinical practice hours a signed supervision agreement is kept on file at the main practice location. With 8,000 certified hours no supervision agreement is required; the PA continues to collaborate with, consult or refer.

none.reason: Renewal rests on nursing practice hours in the five years before renewal or the listed alternatives; the rule and the board's renewal page name no CE hours.

practiceHours.label: At least 960 practice hours in the 5 years before this renewal, or a post-licensure nursing degree or advanced practice certificate within the past five years

ce.reason: Renewal requires current national certification and APRN practice hours; no state CE hours are set.

cycleYears.reason: The certificate expires with the four-year RN license, or earlier when national certification expires.

practiceHours.label: At least 960 advanced practice hours in the 5 years before this renewal, or an advanced practice nursing education program completed within the past five years

topics.label: Opioid related, substance use disorder related or addiction related CE, each renewal cycle

condition.question: Do you hold an active DEA registration?
